title: English Practice Quiz 0938
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A task with high importance and a near deadline should usually be ___.
questions.explanation: Important time-sensitive work needs timely attention.

questions.question: Time blocking means ___.
options: reserving specific periods for planned tasks
questions.explanation: Time blocking assigns calendar periods to particular activities.

questions.question: A realistic daily to-do list should contain ___.
options: tasks that can reasonably be completed
questions.explanation: A manageable list supports focus and completion.

questions.question: Multitasking can reduce accuracy when tasks require ___.
questions.explanation: Switching between attention-demanding tasks can increase errors.

questions.question: A buffer period in a schedule allows for ___.
questions.explanation: Buffer time provides flexibility when work takes longer than expected.

questions.question: A deadline is ___.
options: the latest time by which a task should be completed
the date a task was first discussed
the start of a job interview
questions.explanation: A deadline sets the expected completion time.

questions.question: The phrase 'procrastinate' means to ___.
options: delay doing something that should be done

questions.question: Reviewing your schedule at the end of the day helps you ___.
options: plan priorities for the next day
questions.explanation: A brief review helps organise upcoming work.

questions.question: A recurring task is one that ___.
options: happens repeatedly at regular or expected intervals
questions.explanation: Recurring tasks repeat according to a pattern.

questions.question: When two urgent tasks conflict, you should ___.
options: assess their risks and clarify priorities with the supervisor if needed
complete the easiest one without checking impact
questions.explanation: Clarifying priorities helps ensure the most critical work is addressed.
